'''Rebecca Soler''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Starting with [[S16|the sixteenth season]], she is credited as '''Jessica Paquet'''. She is currently affiliated by Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Soler was born sometime on August 24 in New York City, New York, though she grew up in Boston, Massachusetts; and Sugar Land, Texas. She attended {{wp|Carnegie Mellon University}} and graduated with a bachelor's degree in theater. Afterward, she began a voice-acting career. Soler has worked on the properties for [[4Kids Entertainment]], Central Park Media, Media Blasters, NYAV Post, and [[DuArt Film & Video]]. Her first few roles in {{aniseries|PTS}} were right before the [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy]]; during that time, she voiced [[Kidd Summers]], [[Rhoda]], and {{OBP|Rhonda|AG141}}. Later on, after DuArt took over the dubbing from [[TAJ Productions]], Soler returned to provide voices for the series, starting with ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!]]''. In {{aniseries|SM}}, she provided the voice of {{an|Mallow}}.

Soler departed from the series following ''Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon'', with [[Emily Cramer]] taking on her role as Mallow. In 2020, Soler gave birth to a daughter.
